title: Heuristics in risky decision-making relate to preferential representation of information MEG data
description: This magnetoencephalography (MEG) dataset comprises neuroimaging recordings from participants performing risky decision-making and localizer tasks. The study investigates how heuristics in risky choice relate to preferential neural representation of decision-relevant information. Data include raw MEG recordings across multiple task runs with synchronized event timing via photodiode, preprocessed epoched data, and detailed event information tables mapping stimulus presentations and behavioral responses.
methods_description: MEG data were collected across 13 scanner runs per participant (5 for subject 1) consisting of localizer task runs (runs 1-3), probability learning task runs (runs 4-5), and risky decision-making task runs (6-13). Event timing was recorded using a photodiode accessible as a MEG channel. Data were preprocessed and downsampled, with epoched data extracted from 0-500 ms following task events including stimulus onsets, choice presentations, responses, and outcomes.
